note: Pinned OpenClaw supply for the Hub channel verticals (plan §14.4: public npm, no mirror; the integrity pin is the trust boundary). Each channel pins the shared main package + its own channel package. Integrity is the tarball `dist.integrity` (npm `sha512-…`); the channel packages additionally pin `gitHead` (the main package does not record one on the registry). Telegram is inlined in the main package's dist (no separate channel package), so its `channel` pins the main package itself and its loadMode is `bundled` (file:// URL, no alias surface — plan §7 / table-top finding #0).
